# source; a project's copy is written once and not re-synced (same shape as
# harness_quality_gate.yml, see core/ci_template.py). SKIP, never overwrite:
# unlike the CI workflow this file is one projects already hand-author
# (three corpus projects shipped their own before this template existed),
# so init-project never touches an existing copy, with or without
# --overwrite.
#
# Round 92. secrets_scanning (tier-1, threshold 100) treats a clean gitleaks
# run as proof of no secrets. The framework itself writes free-text agent
# excerpts (test names, coverage summaries) into `.methodology/*.json` and
# commits them (Round 90: the record has to reach git). generic-api-key's
# entropy rule fires on names like `test_invalid_api_key_returns_401` —
# measured on a real project's committed Gate 1 evidence, which blocked P5.
# Scoped to that ONE rule so a real credential under .methodology/ is still
# caught by private-key / aws-access-token / github-pat / etc. — verified:
# a private key planted under .methodology/ is still flagged under this
# config; a real secret outside .methodology/ is unaffected.
